description:
RETURNS A LIVE CREDENTIAL for caches: the connection string includes the password. Treat the result as a secret and do not repeat it anywhere it would be stored or logged.

For PostgreSQL there is no password to return — one is shown only when a role is created, and the server does not keep it — so the result carries host, port and database. Use create_ephemeral_role to obtain a usable credential.
